_about: Maps Forever added that the map conversion (qdb/conversion.json) has no world bounds for. tools/map-extras.js merges these into the conversion. 'estimated' bounds are a guess until the addon records the real ones at login (Core.lua RecordMapBounds -> ForeverRouteDB.mapBounds) and map-extras.js imports them; estimated maps get their own instance id so no distance is ever measured across to a real continent.

maps.exit: The skyship from Valanaar's south-east dock (64.9, 80.9) to Dalaran, then the Skyborne portal in the Violet Citadel to the Stormwind Mage Tower.

Eastern Kingdoms, east of Redridge and Burning Steppes, south of the Badlands, north of the Swamp of Sorrows (warcraft.wiki.gg Riverglades). On foot from Redridge (Blackrock Pass at its north edge; a guard post at Redridge ~97,21). Ship Steamwheedle Port (Tanaris, Wharfmaster Steamfizzle 67.56,23.1) <-> Powderfuse Port (Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz 79.34,52.75), both factions. Flights: Gretchen Mayberry (Alliance, Farholde Keep 60.62,81.53) to Lakeshire, Thelsamar, Morgan's Vigil; Grakna (Horde, Rog'mar 59.58,45.13) to Stonard, Kargath, Flame Crest, Hammerfall (wowforever.be, metabot.gg). No flight master at Powderfuse.
